title: There is no who, knowledge doesn't live within people but across and augmented through networks. Students can never know all tech, instead teach them
summary: There is no who, knowledge doesn't live within people but across and augmented through networks. Students can never know all tech, instead teach them to recognize what they don't know, connect them to passions and people who can answer, and empower. #edtechchat
author: Greg McVerry
